extraction.name: RoboBench
extraction.description: A benchmark for systematically evaluating multimodal large language models as embodied brains for robotic manipulation. It covers instruction comprehension, perception reasoning, generalized planning, affordance prediction, and failure analysis across 25 tasks and 6092 QA pairs.
extraction.creator: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was built from open-source and in-house robotic data, with MLLM- and human-provided annotations. For planning tasks, frame sequences were extracted from high-quality robotic videos and structured annotations were generated by Gemini and refined by human annotators. Failure examples were collected from RoboMIND and labeled by experts, while planning-level failures were synthesized by perturbing correct instructions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open-source and in-house robotic data, including real robot data, curated static attributes, Gemini-segmented video steps, human-labeled bounding boxes, high-quality robotic videos, and RoboMIND failure data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: MLLM- and human-provided annotations were used; Gemini generated structured annotations (task summaries, step-wise instructions with timestamps, and metadata), which were refined by human annotators. Manual annotations were also used for relative positions, key-point changes, human-labeled bounding boxes, affordance types, and expert labeling of execution-level failures.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Post-construction validation was performed by 20 professionally trained annotators who validated linguistic clarity, answerability, and correctness; a majority-vote strategy was also used, with items all models solved correctly removed and items all models failed manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: 20 professionally trained annotators; no further demographic details provided.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini was used to generate structured annotations; LLMs were also used to rewrite explicit instructions into demand-based requests.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Planning-level failures are synthesized by perturbing correct instructions (wrong object, missing step, wrong order).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data were filtered during construction using general and task-specific criteria, including image quality, task validity, and excluding single-arm data from dual-arm tasks; data were also standardized into multiple-choice QA and frame sequences were extracted as standardized inputs.
